templates:
"openssl enc -aes-256-cbc -pbkdf2 -iter 600000" ¬
			& " -in " & quoted form of file_path ¬
			& " -out " & quoted form of dest_path ¬
			& " -pass pass:" & quoted form of the_password

"openssl enc -d -aes-256-cbc -pbkdf2 -iter 600000" ¬
			& " -in " & quoted form of file_path ¬
			& " -out " & quoted form of dest_path ¬
			& " -pass pass:" & quoted form of the_password
